tytul: Ginger jam: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for jam made from ginger.

ostrzezenia.tekst: The FDA list gives ginger a pH of about 5.60–5.90.
Almost any food that is not very acidic, with a pH above 4.6, can support the growth of Clostridium botulinum and toxin production.

akapity: According to Ask Extension, ginger and turmeric have pH levels above the safe level for canning in a boiling water bath.
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for ginger jam from a checked source.
